goal: Have the unattended batch plan projection reuse the shared Spec-binding check so a child that cannot freeze is excluded at planning time, before it is offered for enrollment and before an Executor writes its implementation.

acceptance.assertion: runtime/unattended/batch_plan.ts calls the shared runtime/kernel/spec_binding.ts check for every candidate child and excludes any child whose scope_hint lacks its bound active and archive Spec paths, reporting a stable reason that names the missing paths. The check is advisory at plan time and does not mint, alter, or consume any authority.

Existing batch plan validation is unchanged in every other respect: critical children are still excluded, declared dependency order is still honored, dependents of a skipped child are still skipped, and the plan digest is still computed over the same content.

Plan-time exclusion and enrollment-time refusal agree: a child the plan excludes for a missing Spec binding is the same child enrollment would refuse, verified against the same shared function rather than a second copy of the rule.
